how: We read the website of every Chicago wedding DJ listed on Lazo (108 listings, 85 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: AV production companies, hospitality staffing outfits that also book DJs, and sites that were little more than a menu. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Does the quote include ceremony sound and a wireless mic for the officiant, or is that a second setup fee?
Who is the actual DJ on my date, and can I talk to that person before signing?
Our venue is downtown: do you charge for parking, load-in or overtime if the reception runs late?

picks.name: DJ Chicago
picks.blurb: Established in 2000, DJ Chicago fields a team of DJs with their own genre lists, an online planning portal and MCs for announcements, from the Drake Hotel to Navy Pier. More than 1,000 events across Chicagoland, with a mirror photo booth as an add-on.

picks.name: SSC Entertainment
picks.blurb: Shannon Currie grew up in Englewood in a house where music was the heartbeat and works as DJ and MC in one, so there is a single face from ceremony through last dance. Full professional setup with backup gear, and couples on the site describe him attending the venue walkthrough.

picks.name: Profound Entertainment
picks.blurb: John Herrera has played Chicago and Northwest Indiana since 2010, an open-format DJ rooted in Chicago house who cuts and scratches rather than pressing play. Profound runs its DJs with assistants, keeps the MC work low-key, and offers a photo booth.

picks.name: Dream House Productions
picks.blurb: Chicago's Indian wedding DJ for over ten years, with DJs, MCs and technical staff who handle Baraat, Sangeet, Mehndi and the reception, and Western weddings as well. The team also travels for destination weddings in Cabo, Tulum and the Riviera Maya.

picks.name: DJ D. Jones and The Spark Entertainment Group
picks.blurb: Spark Entertainment Group offers a DJ, live musicians or a hybrid set, including a DJ with a live drummer, and pitches itself against agencies that just fill a calendar. Wedding experiences begin at $2,400 and most couples invest $4,000 to $5,000.

picks.name: Elevated Event Design
picks.blurb: Armond Cozzi started DJing in 2006 and built Elevated Event Design in Willowbrook as a DJ, lighting and photo booth company, with his Magic Moment Photo Booth alongside. The team coordinates with the venue and planner to keep the timeline on schedule.

picks.name: Grand Dj Entertainment
picks.blurb: A full-time DJ group in Grayslake led by Craig, who has planned and performed at more than 1,000 weddings and events over 20 years. Covers Chicagoland and southern Wisconsin, with online planning tools for playlists and timelines.

picks.name: Show On The Road Productions Entertainment, Inc.
picks.blurb: Show on the Road has worked more than 10,000 events since 1995 out of Naperville, including weddings, school dances and corporate galas. Fully insured, early arrival and backup equipment on site, with a photo booth and keepsake album as options.

picks.name: Boulder Terrace Sound
picks.blurb: Jeff personally plans and DJs every event, serving couples since 2003 from Plano, with packages priced for unlimited time from $1,850. Full-range speakers and subwoofers, dance floor lighting, wireless mics and liability insurance are included.

picks.name: An Enchanted Evening
picks.blurb: Schaumburg's An Enchanted Evening has over 25 years, 8,000-plus events and more than 300 a year, with dozens of DJs plus lighting, photo booths and event production. Uplighting, pin spotting and monogram projection come from the same team.

picks.name: Buena Beats
picks.blurb: A bilingual DJ and MC service that announces and coordinates in English and Spanish so every guest follows along, for weddings and quinceañeras. Naperville-based, with photo booth, monogram projection and wedding planning as add-ons and an online song catalog for planning.

picks.name: SoundTastik DJ
picks.blurb: Since 1985, Soundtastik has DJed weddings, school dances and parties around Joliet, Plainfield, Shorewood, Lockport, New Lenox and Naperville. The team builds a timeline with each couple, coordinates with vendors and handles announcements from grand entrance to last dance.
